observations.observation: state complete-design is the strict design confirmation: when the design doc carries frontmatter it must declare the binding triple comet_change: <change>, role: technical-design, canonical_spec: openspec; without the triple the command refuses (naming 'Design Doc …' checks) AFTER registering the design_doc reference, and `state transition design-complete` is the phase driver (design -> build). Managed use should author the frontmatter triple so the strict path passes (both recipes drive the same gate set).

the build-complete/verify-pass transitions rewrite .comet.yaml and drop the verification_report field when it was recorded before the transition; `state set verification_report` must (re-)run at the verify phase, where the field persists (state set additionally requires the report file to exist). The escape-path probe records this ordering.

comet knowledge remember stores $HOME/Library/Caches/Comet/project-knowledge/<project-hash>/memory/<slug>.md; knowledge list additionally exposes Comet-generated topology records (provider=local). Nothing in either flow touches LLMWiki/Outline/DeepWiki.
